question: What API endpoint do I use to change the voice in an existing audio recording?
ground_truth: Use the POST /v1/speech-to-speech/{voice_id} endpoint (Voice Changer) to transform audio from one voice to another. This endpoint accepts multipart/form-data with an audio file. Required: voice_id in the path (the target voice), xi-api-key header, and the audio file. Optional parameters include model_id (e.g., 'eleven_multilingual_sts_v2'), voice_settings, seed for reproducibility, remove_background_noise (boolean) for noise reduction, and file_format to specify input format. The response is binary audio (application/octet-stream) with the transformed voice.

correctness: Must mention it requires an audio file input
Must mention voice_id determines the target voice
